summary: Executed targeted density-regression validation for Scope 1 Create Emission flows (UI + API) on live preview. Backend density contract checks passed; frontend confirms conditional density visibility/default behavior for mismatch vs same-dimension paths, with one flaky modal-open blocker during save-toast validation.

ui_bugs.issue: Intermittent failure to open Add Emission modal after clicking [data-testid='add-emission-button'] (selector for modal root not appearing in repeated run), blocking deterministic validation of save-time density toast messaging.

integration_issues.flow: Monthly Qty Basis EF save-path error-message validation
integration_issues.issue: Could not complete final assertion for save-time density-specific toast vs generic calculator error due intermittent modal-open flake in final validation run.

action_items: Investigate flaky Add Emission modal open behavior from GHG Logs page before finalizing save-path UI assertions.
Re-run UI save-path validation for Qty Basis mismatch to explicitly confirm density-specific validation toast and absence of generic 'Cannot convert ef_quantity' error.
Optional maintainability: split oversized files Step3YearMonthlyData.js, EmissionEntryForm.js, and backend/modules/emissions/router.py into smaller modules to reduce regression risk.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/modules/ghg/emissions/shared/components/steps/Step3YearMonthlyData.js remains very large (>1200 lines), increasing defect risk in density/methodology conditional rendering.
frontend/src/components/EmissionEntryForm.js is oversized and still orchestrates many coupled concerns, making density path regressions harder to isolate.
backend/modules/emissions/router.py is oversized and mixes validation + workflow + persistence concerns; density contract logic should remain isolated/testable as API evolves.
seed_data_creation: No explicit seed data created. Temporary emission records created by tests were cleaned up via teardown fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified in UI: (1) Qty Basis + Diesel (volume qty vs mass EF denominator) shows Density column with default value and Override Default toggle, (2) Qty Basis + Anthracite same-dimension default (kg qty and kgCO2/kg EF) hides density entirely, (3) switching Anthracite EF unit to kgCO2/L surfaces required Density input with L/kg and no override toggle/default. Backend API contracts for POST/PUT mismatch density guards and carbon-composition same-dimension acceptance passed.
rca of the issue: UI blocker appears intermittent on modal open from GHG Logs: add button click occasionally leaves user on logs table without mounting modal form DOM ([data-testid='emission-facility-select'] absent), likely timing/state race in dialog mount path rather than selector mismatch. This prevented final save-toast assertion in the last run, while earlier runs successfully opened the modal and validated conditional density rendering states.
